```{r}

ps <- pylsq

ps_rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps, function(x) x / sum(x))

# (PCoA-plot)

ord_bc <- ordinate(ps_rel, method = "PCoA", distance = "bray")

plot_ordination(ps_rel, ord_bc, color = "Country") +
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "PCoA: Geographical differences in microbiomes",
    subtitle = "Based on Bray-Curtis differences (Genus-level)",
    color = "Land",
    caption = "Global PERMANOVA: R² = 12.5%, p = 0.001\nGlobal Dispersion (Country): p < 0.001"
  )
```

```{r}
# PCoA - health status by country 

ord_bc <- ordinate(ps_rel, method = "PCoA", distance = "bray")

plot_ordination(ps_rel, ord_bc, color = "Disease.MESH.ID") +
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~Country) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("D003093" = "#E41A1C", "D006262" = "#377EB8"),
    labels = c("D003093" = "Ulcerative Colitis", "D006262" = "Healthy Control")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "PCoA: Ulcerative Colitis based divided by country",
    subtitle = "Divided by geography and healthstatus (MESH ID)",
    color = "Status",
    caption = "Disease effect controlled for geography (Global Model):\nPERMANOVA p = 0.001\nGlobal Sickness Dispersion p < 0.001"
  )

```

```{r}
top20_genera <- names(sort(taxa_sums(ps_rel), decreasing = TRUE)[1:20])
ps_top20 <- prune_taxa(top20_genera, ps_rel)

plot_bar(ps_top20, fill = "Genus") +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", color=NA) +  
  facet_grid(Disease.name ~ Country, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(x = "Patienter / Testpersoner", y = "Relativ overflod (Procent)",
       title = "Top 20 dominating genuses",
       subtitle = "Divided by country (columns) and healthstatus (rows)")
```

```{r}

# removing N/A
ps_global_clean <- prune_samples(sample_sums(ps_rel) > 0, ps_rel)
ps_global_clean <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_global_clean) > 0, ps_global_clean)

# data for global test
bray_dist_global <- distance(ps_global_clean, method = "bray")
bakterie_global  <- as(otu_table(ps_global_clean), "matrix")
if(taxa_are_rows(ps_global_clean)) { bakterie_global <- t(bakterie_global) }
metadata_global  <- data.frame(as(sample_data(ps_global_clean), "data.frame"))

# Global PERMANOVA
permanova_global <- adonis2(bakterie_global ~ Country + Disease.MESH.ID, 
                            data = metadata_global, 
                            method = "bray")

print("--- GLOBAL PERMANOVA TEST ---")
print(permanova_global)

# Global Betadisper 
print("--- GLOBAL DISPERSION TEST: COUNTRY ---")
disp_global_country <- betadisper(bray_dist_global, metadata_global$Country, type = "centroid")
print(anova(disp_global_country))

print("--- GLOBAL DISPERSION TEST: DISEASE ---")
disp_global_disease <- betadisper(bray_dist_global, metadata_global$Disease.MESH.ID, type = "centroid")
print(anova(disp_global_disease))


```
